summary: Use production data to analyze OEE, bottlenecks and losses. Explore the five-day foundation course and build practical reporting skills.
lede: Data analytics for manufacturing and operations turns shop-floor records into evidence for production decisions. For production supervisors, process engineers and operations analysts, it covers checking records, calculating OEE, and analyzing throughput, cycle time and production losses in Excel. Learners also map data trails, investigate bottlenecks using work-in-progress measures, and prepare KPI views and decision briefs that state assumptions and data limitations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who interpret production records, coordinate shop-floor responses or report manufacturing performance. It suits foundation-level learners who want a practical method for checking operational data and linking it to production decisions.
modules: Value Stream Mapping for Production Flow
Excel KPI Views and Decision Briefs
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with production, quality, maintenance or operations records is useful. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel; no add-ins are required.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
